clos.original_description: Identify relevant generative-AI techniques (LLMs, diffusion, multimodal, RAG, agents, fine-tuning, alignment) for a capstone topic.
clos.enriched_description: Identify relevant generative-AI techniques (LLMs, diffusion, multimodal, RAG, agents, fine-tuning, alignment) for a capstone topic. The scope includes [Chapter 1: Course Introduction and Group Formation] Introduction to the course; Discussion on the Generative AI Capstone Project (GAP) topic, scope, feasibility, current frontier areas; Formation of teams/groups (2-3 members); roles and responsibilities; Discuss and choose a project topic; verify dataset/model licensing and compute feasibility on a single GPU; and References related to Report 1, required readings on the proposed approach (seminal papers and recent results).

clos.original_description: Formulate problem statements, scope, objectives, and success criteria in a project proposal.
clos.enriched_description: Formulate generative-AI project problem statements, scope, objectives, and success criteria. The scope includes topic selection with dataset/model licensing and compute feasibility, proposal guidance covering problem statement, related work, modalities/models, evaluation plan and compute budget, scoping, novelty checks, differentiation from off-the-shelf API use, required readings, proposal writing, and proposal improvement.

clos.original_description: Plan data preparation, model selection, and licensing/ethics review.
clos.enriched_description: Plan data preparation, model selection, and licensing or ethics review for a generative-AI project. The scope includes dataset licensing, preprocessing, tokenization, data preparation discussion and improvement, hosted versus open-weight model selection, model size, license and cost considerations, data and baseline submission, and baseline improvement.

clos.original_description: Conduct baseline analysis using pre-trained models, prompting, and in-context learning.
clos.enriched_description: Conduct baseline analysis using pre-trained models, prompting, and in-context learning. The scope includes zero-shot and few-shot baselines, structured prompt engineering, baseline and prompt discussion, prompt engineering improvement, data and baseline submission, and baseline improvement.

clos.original_description: Develop and adapt generative-AI systems to project requirements.
clos.enriched_description: Develop and adapt generative-AI systems to project requirements. The scope includes choosing adaptation paths such as prompt-only, RAG, LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning, or agent/tool-use designs, model adaptation discussion, adaptation improvement, model-results submission, and model-results improvement.

clos.original_description: Evaluate and optimize systems using appropriate metrics and protocols, with attention to contamination and saturation.
clos.enriched_description: Evaluate and optimize generative-AI systems using appropriate metrics and iteration protocols. The scope includes metrics such as perplexity, ROUGE, faithfulness, FID, BLEU, human or LLM-based evaluation, evaluation and iteration discussion, iteration improvement, model-results submission, and model-results improvement.

clos.original_description: Interpret outputs and failure modes (hallucination, bias, jailbreak) and visualize results for stakeholders.
clos.enriched_description: Interpret outputs and failure modes, including hallucination, bias, jailbreak, grounding, and demo behavior, and visualize results for stakeholders. The scope includes results, demo, and failure-mode analysis; supporting references; failure-mode discussion; improvement cycles; model-results submission; and model-results improvement.

clos.original_description: Summarize conclusions and actionable recommendations, including deployment and cost/latency trade-offs.
clos.enriched_description: Summarize conclusions and actionable recommendations, including deployment and cost/latency trade-offs. The scope includes [Chapter 8: Conclusion, Ethics, and Recommendations] Guide Report No.3: Model & Result [Part 4: Conclusion and References related to Report No.3: Conclusion, Ethics, and Recommendations.

clos.original_description: Compile a final report with an explicit ethics, safety, and provenance subsection.
clos.enriched_description: Compile a final report with an explicit ethics, safety, and provenance subsection. The scope includes [Chapter 8: Conclusion, Ethics, and Recommendations] Guide Report No.3: Model & Result [Part 4: Conclusion; References related to Report No.3: Conclusion, Ethics, and Recommendations; [Chapter 9: Finalization and Presentations] Guide Final Report, Report 4 integration: combining Reports 1-3; and References related to Final Report (template, examples, rubric).

clos.original_description: Deliver oral presentations with live demonstrations and Q&A defense.
clos.enriched_description: Deliver oral presentations with live demonstrations and Q&A defense. The scope includes Practice for Presentation of Capstone Project, demo dry-run, Q&A defence, individual contribution statement; Practice for Presentation of Capstone Project, polish slides, rehearse failure-mode discussion, ethics; and Practice for Presentation of Capstone Project, final rehearsal before Final Exam (oral group presentation).
